notes.title: Major drop system update!
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, players![/h1]

Here's a quick overview of what has changed:

[list][*] Fixed an issue with item drops
[*] Added progress saving between game sessions
[*] Reduced the impact of bot holders and multi-accounting
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed dishonest players to receive sticker packs before the 2-hour timer expired
[*] Temporarily removed the captcha[/list]
[h3]Developer Comments:[/h3]

Since the early stages of the game, we were dissatisfied that the core mechanic of the project was out of our control, which prevented us from fully addressing many issues due to our dependence on a third party.

Additionally, we encountered a major security problem. Due to a vulnerability on Steam's side, there was an exploit that allowed dishonest players to obtain sticker packs unfairly.

[b]With the 2.4 update, we are completely overhauling the internal item drop system.[/b]

Roger Miller (CTO) said:
[quote]"The development of the new item drop system began at the end of August. It was strategically planned from the very launch of the game, but due to circumstances and other core issues, the development timeline was significantly extended"[/quote] 
We are also [b]temporarily removing the captcha.[/b] Feedback from players made us realize we can improve this system.

Thank you for staying with us!

[i]Sincerely,
The VHC Team![/i]

notes.title: Enhancing your game experience
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, players![/h1]

We’ve slightly deviated from our original plan because we realized we could improve the game right now!

In this update, we’re introducing two simple but important tools to make life easier for players and reduce the impact of bot farms.

[h3]New "Refresh" button on the Main Screen[/h3]
This button allows players to refresh their data [b]without waiting for the automatic update.[/b] If you’ve purchased sticker packs but don’t see them in the game, just press this button, and your problem will be solved!

[h3]Prove you are a human upon logging in![/h3]
Now, when logging into the game, [b]you’ll be required to enter a captcha.[/b] We hope this will significantly reduce the influence of bot farm owners. While we maintain our stance of not being against multi-accounting, we understand that some players might abuse the system and affect experience of others. That’s why we are aiming to reduce the efficiency of bot farms.

We will continue to monitor the situation and make adjustments as necessary! Thank you for staying with us!

[i]Sincerely,
The VHC Team![/i]

notes.title: Developer Diary #2
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, players![/h1]

Lead game designer at VHC, Sergio Gomez is speaking! We’ve reached the halfway point of Season 2, bringing new changes, new players, and a lot of feedback, for which we are truly grateful! Thank you for helping us improve!

The first topic we’ll cover in this diary and the next update is the [b]Seasonal Achievement System[/b].

[h2]Global changes to achievement system[/h2]

[h3]All Seasonal Achievements (Steam) will be removed from the game.[/h3]

One of the most requested features was the ability to complete the game 100%. Seasonal achievements were a major roadblock for this goal.

Firstly, they relied on limited resources, meaning each month it became harder to achieve them, eventually becoming almost impossible. Secondly, some achievements were extremely difficult, bordering on unachievable. Moving forward, achievements will be divided into [b]Global (Steam)[/b] and [b]Internal[/b] categories.

[b]Global Achievements:[/b]
[list][*] Can be earned at any time.
[*] Do not depend on limited resources.[/list]

We will continue adding global achievements to Steam for some time (until the game becomes fully self-sufficient), after which we will leave them unchanged.

[b]Internal Achievements:[/b][list]
[*] Highlight players who spend a lot of time in the game.
[*] Grant additional points to the ranking system.
[*] Rely on limited resources.
[*] Serve as a new form of collectible content.[/list]

The "EVO" mechanics will remain, [i]except for the leaderboard tasks, which will be completely removed from the game.[/i] Upon completing internal achievements, players will now receive [b]Pins[/b], which will be displayed on a dedicated page.

[h3]Pins[/h3]

Pins are a new, more challenging form of collectible content. One pin page will be in focus for 12 seasons (1 year). [i]Unfocused pin pages will still be achievable.[/i]

[b]How to earn Pins:[/b]
[list]
[*] By completing achievements on seasonal sticker pack pages.
[*] By randomly dropping in place of a sticker pack [i](the chance will be extremely low, and the drop time limited to the season).[/i]
[*] Through other activities [i](we are currently considering giving pins to active community members).[/i]
[/list]

[b]Other Details:[/b]
[list]
[*] Players will no longer earn ranking points for completing achievements.
[*] Pins will have rarities.
[*] Pins will grant ranking points.
[*] Points for pins will not be included in the 10% addition after each season.
[/list]

[h2]Season 3[/h2]

We have already started working on the third collection, and even for pixel art, it's turning out to be quite square! ;)

[h3]Customization[/h3]

After the release of the [b]Pins[/b], [b]Leaderboard redesign[/b], and [b]Season 3[/b], we will finally introduce one of the most exciting features of our project: [b]Profile Customization[/b].

We want to make our game [b]more social[/b], so we believe that personalizing collectors' profiles is of great importance.

[list]
[*] Every player will have a main profile page that can be customized to showcase the crown jewels of their collection.
[*] Customization will include background images, player banners, and more.
[/list]

[b]How can players unlock customization?[/b]

Initially, customization will only be available to those who own complete collections. For each full collection, the player earns 1 level. Each level unlocks new customization features!

Later, we will introduce an in-game currency, but more on that in the future.

[h2]Future plans[/h2]

Due to shifting priorities, the roadmap has been slightly adjusted, and the [b]Referral[/b] and [b]Betting[/b] systems have been postponed.

We also aim to deepen the clicker mechanics and add more social interaction. Through this, we hope to motivate players to visit each other's profiles. However, we are not ready to share more details at this time.

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]

If you’ve read this far, here’s a personal <3 from me! Thank you for being so invested in the development of the project! Your enthusiasm inspires us and motivates us to achieve even more!

Please keep sharing your experiences with us; we are always open to communication!

[i]Sincerely,
The VHC Team![/i]

notes.title: Regarding User Bans
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, players![/h1]

[i]We want to inform you that exploiting bugs to gain an unfair advantage over other players is considered a form of cheating, which will lead to your account being banned from the game.[/i]

[b]Catherine Walker [i](CEO)[/i][/b] comments on the situation:

[quote]We deeply regret that a security vulnerability in the game has led to such serious consequences and disagreements within our community.

We must all remember that if you find someone’s wallet on the street and take money from it, the police won’t care that the victim lost it. You will be the one judged.

Before banning players, we extensively consulted with Steam employees to confirm whether our game can be considered multiplayer and whether it was ethical to ban players who exploited bugs to obtain illegal items.

To those accusing us of using this loophole to deceive, first, provide evidence to avoid making empty claims. Second, you should have reported the bug to us before the bans were issued.

As an apology to the gaming community, I have decided to [b]dismiss every seventh employee[/b] working on [i]Collectibles![/i] as a lesson. According to the contracts with the dismissed workers, [b]we will also take custody of their firstborns to train them as new specialists to fill the vacated positions.[/b][/quote]
[i]Sincerely,
The VHC Team![/i]

notes.title: Developer Diary #1
notes.content:
[h1]Hello, players![/h1]

This is Sergio Gomez, [b]the lead game designer at VHC![/b] Today, I want to talk to you about [i]Collectibles![/i]

In this diary, I’ll be sharing the philosophy and significance of this project for our company, as well as discussing the plans we’ve set to enhance the player experience.

When Catherine Walker called me with the offer to become the lead game designer at VHC, the first thing I asked about was the company’s philosophy regarding its games. Catherine responded, [i]"Our goal is to create games that people can play for hours on end."[/i] This intrigued me because it sounded like a challenge. Is it really possible to make a game that people would play even while sleeping? After a lot of research, trials, and errors, we concluded that it is possible, and that’s how [b]Collectibles[/b] was born!

Currently, the project's [b]potential is only about 20% realized.[/b] Why so little? The answer is simple. We wanted to ride the wave of the genre’s popularity and develop this genre further with a live audience.

[h2]Second Season[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
In the second season, we will focus on deepening the gameplay experience, creating a more flexible interface, enhancing the endgame, and introducing new interactive elements, whose potential will be revealed in the future.

[h3]Deepening the Gameplay Experience[/h3]

As practice has shown, even now, it takes an active player only 1-2 weeks to complete a full collection. Considering the season lasts a month, it’s important for us to add more challenges.

Measures to be taken:

[list]
[*] Introducing an additional rarity: [b]Divine[/b]
[*] Changing the drop rate for items:

[list]
[*] Common 70% -> 77.5%
[*] Rare 19% -> 15%
[*] Epic 8% -> 5%
[*] Legendary 2.5% -> 2%
[*] Forbidden 0.5% -> 0.4%
[*] Divine 0% -> 0.1%
[/list][/list]
[h3]Enhancing the Endgame[/h3]

It’s important for us to support the game’s economy, so we want to create more opportunities for challenges and scoring points for players aiming to top the leaderboard.

Measures to be taken:

[list]
[*] Adding a clicker counter
[*] Increasing the difficulty of the clicker
[*] Evolving seasonal achievements [i](Bronze/Silver/Gold)[/i]
[/list]
[h3]Creating more flexible Interface[/h3]
[list]
[*] Creating a text-based interface
[*] Preparing the interface for more advanced filtering/sorting
[*] Displaying and switching between different seasons/stickers/sticker packs
[/list]
[h3]New Interactive Elements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Displaying the number of views for players in the leaderboard [i](Number of profile visits)[/i]
[*] Adding the ability to "like" favorite collections [i](In the future, certain rewards will be given for likes)[/i]
[/list]
[h2]Plans for Future Seasons[/h2]
[hr][/hr]
We’ve already shared our plans for the next 3 months in the roadmap we recently published. So, I’ll just reiterate what you can expect: profile customization, a referral system, in-game currency, and mini-games! We promise it’s going to be fun! BUT! That’s not all!

[i]I’ll let you in on a secret[/i]—we want to grow our community, so we will continue to release free games with active gameplay! We hope to release the first of these games in late fall or early winter. We can’t share details about the graphics or gameplay just yet, but we will definitely do so later! So, stay with us and keep an eye on the news from [b]VHC[/b] and [b][i]Collectibles![/i][/b] in our [u][url=https://discord.gg/AKr4Eve7yG]Discord[/url][/u]. [b]Our adventure is just beginning![/b]

notes.title: Collectibles! receives key technical updates
notes.content:
[h2]Hello, players![/h2]

We are excited to introduce the second update for Collectibles!

This patch includes a wide range of technical fixes:

[h3]Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with achievement unlocking.
[*] Fixed a problem with incorrect point calculation for collections for some players.
[*] Fixed an issue where the leaderboard score was displayed incorrectly for certain players.
[*] Corrected the formula for point calculation when burning items.
[*] Fixed a problem with sticker pack distribution that affected some players.
[/list]
[h3]QoL:[/h3]
[list]
[*] The outline of stickers added to the collection is now hidden.
[*] Added a loading indicator when burning or crafting items.
[*] Added automatic disabling of page navigation buttons when the minimum or maximum page in the leaderboard is reached.
[/list]

We understand that the previous version of the game may have led to a negative experience, which is very unfortunate for us. We sincerely apologize to all players who faced difficulties in recent days.

We also want to express our heartfelt thanks to the players who shared their feedback with us, both on our [url=https://discord.gg/AKr4Eve7yG]Discord server[/url] and in Steam reviews! This means a lot to us and our community!

[b]Soon, we will present the changes that will follow the release of the second season, but for now, stay with us and keep collecting![/b]

[i]Sincerely,
The VHC Team![/i]
